desc: Remington is proud to provide shooters with a cleaning kit designed to keep lever guns clean. Brass rods and components feature Mil-spec 8-32 threads which allows for compatibility. Includes: Premier Handle, (4) 9 brass rods, Double end nylon brush, (3) bronze brushes with coated steel twists, 30cal, 35cal, 45cal, (1) brass jags, (1) flathead screwdriver, (20) 1.5" patches
